newsitem.title: UK: Czech SEC proposal to face govt scrutiny Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Czech SEC proposal to face govt scrutiny Wednesday.

text.p: The Czech government on Wednesday will be handed details of the finance ministry's proposal to create an independent securities commmision (CzSEC), Tomas Jezek, chairman of the Prague stock exchange, told an investor conference on Tuesday.
"This is the most important issue and will be viewed by the government on Wednesday afternoon," Jezek, a long-time promoter of the project, said.
